description: Layer 2 of the track: everything the model sees on each call (prompt, examples, history, documents, memory, tool results).
Structuring the instructions of a call: role, task, constraints, examples, output format and delimiters.
Deciding everything the model sees per call under a budget: write, select, compress and isolate.
Model output with a schema your code validates before using it, with repair and bounded retries.
Versioned, reviewed and tested prompts, released per environment with rollback.
Quality degrading as context grows with irrelevant material, well within the context window.
